decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The details of the refuse storage as shown on submitted drawing number 1380.12 would provide satisfactory arrangements for the storage of waste and recycled materials in line with policy ENV-B.1.1 (New Development) of the adopted Hounslow Unitary Development Plan.

Informative
Environmental Direct Services advice that the refuse storage bins should be galvanised metal and not plastic, to reduce the risk of damage from vandalism.
description: Following approval for demolition of the existing (former) London Transport Sports Pavilion and erection of new sports and social clubhouse with tied-caretaker accommodation at first floor level, together with reinstatement of bowling green, 3 tennis courts and 1 netball court, new 44 space car park, looped foothpath access to open space with new access to Great West Road details submitted pursuant to Condition 14 (refuse) of planning permission reference 00505/CH/P6 dated 15/03/2004.
